value_grammar.decimal: Finite decimal, optionally in scientific notation: an optional leading '-', digits with an optional '.', then an optional exponent 'e' or 'E' with an optional '+' or '-' and one or more digits. No leading '+', whitespace, hexadecimal, infinity, NaN, or trailing characters. The value must be finite and inside the option's documented range; the decimal point is '.' in every locale.
value_grammar.window: Decimal digits only; odd integer in [3,4095]. No sign, whitespace, fraction or exponent.

options.name: --out-dir
options.description: Paths must be well-formed UTF-8 and are never normalized or repaired. Parent must exist. Publish result.png into a new directory only after complete processing. Existing destinations are never replaced.

options.name: --output-mode
options.description: Preserve keeps the decoded gray/color category, not source bytes, ICC space, metadata or alpha. Continuous output has no enhancement filter and is verified before publication. Gray converts linear luminance; bw explicitly activates stored-sample binarization.

options.name: --bit-depth
options.description: Continuous output only. Auto retains 16-bit source precision, otherwise 8. Explicit 16-to-8 reduction is reported; no precision fallback is used for resource limits.

options.name: --alpha
options.description: Continuous output only. Composite straight PNG alpha over white or black in linear light; reject refuses any non-opaque pixel. Output is opaque.

options.name: --profile-policy
options.description: Continuous output only. Interpret supported cICP, compatible ICC, sRGB or gAMA/cHRM; otherwise report an sRGB assumption. srgb explicitly overrides color declarations, not integrity or orientation checks. Unsupported HDR/cICP is rejected by embedded policy.

options.name: --binarize
options.description: Requires explicit --output-mode bw. B02/B03 use stored 1/2/4/8-bit grayscale PNG samples without transparency and output 8-bit black/white; no color or gamma conversion is applied.

options.name: --fixed-threshold
options.description: B03 only. Normalized grayscale threshold; black iff sample/255 <= T. Rejected for Sauvola.

options.name: --sauvola-window
options.description: B02 only. Centered square window with REFLECT_101 borders; a singleton dimension repeats its sample.

options.name: --sauvola-k
options.description: B02 only. Weight in T=m*(1+k*(s/(255*R)-1)), using population standard deviation in stored byte units.

options.name: --sauvola-r
options.description: B02 only. Normalized deviation scale: 0.5 means 127.5 in byte units, not 128. Black iff sample <= T; no threshold rounding or clipping.

options.name: --json
options.description: Render one JSON response on stdout and no diagnostic text on stderr. Flush the selected stream before returning. JSON exit_code describes the rendered command outcome; response-delivery failure can instead end the process with exit 5. Check both the response and process status. A missing/incomplete response or exit 5 does not prove that publication did not commit; do not retry blindly.

options.name: --help
options.description: Renders help and exits without opening input or creating output.

options.name: --version
options.description: Human-readable alias of `version`.

options.name: --illumination
options.description: Select I01 for continuous preserve/gray output only. Off is the default; auto may skip for explicitly reported applicability predicates.

options.name: --background-strength
options.description: Exponent controlling I01 gain. Zero is an exact photometric no-op after parameter and mask validation.

options.name: --background-max-gain
options.description: Maximum I01 multiplicative gain. One is an exact photometric no-op.

options.name: --background-target
options.description: Linear-light target. Source uses the fitted background nearest-rank 90th percentile, not forced paper white.

options.name: --background-cell
options.description: Cell edge in oriented pixels. Auto is round(min(width,height)/24), clamped to [16,256]. Resource refusal never changes this value.

options.name: --background-quantile
options.description: Nearest-rank quantile of all eligible cell samples; protected samples are excluded.

options.name: --background-smooth
options.description: Positive grid-Laplacian weight for fitting the logarithmic background.

options.name: --protect-mask
options.description: 1-bit or 8-bit grayscale PNG mask matching oriented source dimensions. Nonzero protects. Any alpha must be fully opaque; mask orientation must be normal. The mask is validated even when illumination is disabled.
